ownership: Strategic Latitude Intelligence independent indicator taxonomy, designed for Indonesia-focused strategic research.
coverage: 80 indicators in eight research domains. Populated values reference existing dated SLI snapshots; definitions alone are NOT verified data.

scoring_policy.normalization: Risk subscore may be calculated only after source-specific risk direction, comparable denominator, historical baseline, minimum observation coverage and documented fixed or empirically justified thresholds.
scoring_policy.example_formula: Risk_i = 100 * clamp((x_i - safe_i)/(critical_i - safe_i), 0, 1) only when higher values objectively imply higher exposure and thresholds are approved; invert where appropriate. Not applicable to policy-event binary leads without separate event verification.
scoring_policy.readiness: Separate verified organizational control evidence from macro indicators; cannot derive organizational maturity from national GDP or news headlines.
scoring_policy.aggregation: Weighted domain score = sum_i(w_i * score_i)/sum_i(w_i), calculated only if sufficient required indicators meet the coverage rule; no missing=zero; weights and coverage published.
scoring_policy.coverage_gate: Require at least 70% of required indicator weight observed, plus all declared core indicators, before any composite score; otherwise N/A.
scoring_policy.blindspots: List missing observations, undocumented thresholds, absent controls, stale sources and unresolved causal mechanisms.
scoring_policy.uncertainty: Report observation vintages, changes in definition, threshold sensitivity; scenario hypotheses do not produce calibrated probabilities.
scoring_policy.ai_disclosure: AI may assist metadata preparation and categorization; do not accept an AI-generated citation or score without primary-source verification.
